Energistyrelsen (Danish Energy Agency) (2015). Kortlaegning af energisparepotentialer i erhvervslivet, Slutrapport (Mapping of energy-saving potentials in business, final report), June 2015. Prepared by COWI (Kromann, M., Kragerup, H., Dalsgaard, M.), project A065646.

Printed page numbers (not PDF pages) used. Region Denmark, DKK, 2015; no price year printed, so DKK and EUR amounts carry the publication-year flag. The report is a potentials catalogue: each case table gives E (saving potential %), A (share of the sector use to which the case applies) and I (investment cost in DKK per kWh, taken as per kWh of annual energy use/saving after installation; D = change in O&M). These are measure-level and go to _measures (one row per case table with the branch ranges folded into the note); no payback is printed per case except where stated (the report derives payback classes 2/4/10 years from I and saving). Main file holds only technology-level numbers: heat-pump COPs (10 to 80 C ammonia comparison, excess-heat case COP 4.5 at 1.0 DKK/kWh), temperature and size limits by refrigerant, straw boiler efficiencies (35-40% old, about 55% fleet, 80% new) and the tunnel pasteuriser. Not loaded: lighting, motors, fans, refrigeration, IT, hydraulics, compressed-air and pump technologies beyond measures; the 2015 re-assessment tables (savings by payback class) and automation chapters (cross-cutting, no technology numbers). Danish text read in translation; Table 7-15 investment prints as 10,5 and may be a column merge.
